title: A failure two steps in
request:
the chain started, one step acknowledged, the next failed

./your_program.sh saga-choreo
init ["reserve","charge","ship"]
event start
event reserve.ok
event charge.fail
event reserve.undone
ledger
outcome
note: Nothing here decides anything: `charge.fail` emits `reserve.undo` because that is the rule the reserve service subscribes to, and the chain stops when it runs out of earlier steps. The order is the reverse of the forward chain for the same reason it is in an orchestrated saga — each undo is triggered by the one after it.

title: A bus that delivers the same event twice
request:
one acknowledgement, delivered twice

./your_program.sh saga-choreo
init ["reserve","charge","ship"]
event start
event reserve.ok
event reserve.ok
ledger
note: At-least-once is the only delivery a broker can really offer, so the second copy is not an error — it is the normal case. A handler that is not idempotent per event charges the card twice here, and no amount of care further down the chain undoes that.
